# From raw files to a paper-scale SCOP workflow

Learn how to read common single-cell formats, audit and quality-control one or many samples, integrate sources, annotate cells, run advanced analyses, and analyse spatial transcriptomics. Every primary figure below was generated from a real dataset—not a synthetic illustration.

[Start the curriculum](start-here.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [中文教程](zh/index.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-light}
:::

## The curriculum spine

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.lesson-card}
### 01 · Get data in

Choose the correct reader for H5, a three-file 10x directory, RDS, H5AD, or Loom. A public PBMC 1k H5 is round-tripped through three-file and RDS forms.

[Input formats →](input-formats.qmd)
:::
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.lesson-card}
### 02 · Build trustworthy objects

Measure QC before thresholds, call doublets, join Seurat v5 layers, examine cluster stability, and select dimensions from evidence.

[Single sample →](single-cell-case.qmd)
:::
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.lesson-card}
### 03 · Scale to studies

Keep sample identity, integrate technical sources, validate biology preservation, annotate by evidence, and use pseudobulk for sample-level inference.

[Multi-sample →](multi-sample.qmd)
:::
:::
:::

## What the executed evidence shows

![Real cross-source pancreas cells before and after SCT plus Harmony integration.](assets/figures/real-data/cross-source-integration.png){fig-alt="Three UMAP panels show pancreatic cells before Harmony by source, after Harmony by source, and after Harmony by cell type."}

On `panc8_sub`, the fraction of neighbours drawn from another technical source rose from **0.2169 to 0.6765**, while same-cell-type neighbourhood preservation rose from **0.9379 to 0.9616**. This supports the integration code path; it does not turn technical sources into biological replicates.

## Where this can take a paper

The [paper-scale framework](paper-framework.qmd) connects inputs, QC, integration, annotation, differential analysis, enrichment, composition, trajectory, communication, regulation, metabolism, malignancy, and spatial analysis to explicit research questions and claim boundaries. Heavy optional modules are never shown as “completed” unless their backend actually ran.

::: {.boundary}
**Evidence boundary.** This site proves executable workflows on the named datasets and runtime. It does not prove that a method is appropriate for every study, and it does not convert bundled example data into new biological discovery.
:::
